assets.prompt: A cozy cartoon workshop wall with a pegboard and empty shelves, a long clear wooden workbench across the bottom with a bare empty top, warm light, flat bright illustration.

assets.sd: A cozy cartoon workshop seen straight on: a pegboard wall with a few hanging tools and wooden shelves with jars high up on the wall, and a long wide wooden workbench across the bottom of the picture whose clean bare top surface is completely clear, warm light, flat bright illustration.

assets.name: shelf
assets.prompt: A single long honey-brown wooden wall shelf with two blue-grey metal brackets and brass screws, straight-on front view. Warm storybook gouache and colored pencil, gentle upper-left light, subtle wood grain. Bare upper surface, about five to one proportions, centered with small margins on perfectly flat pure green. No text, people, other objects or cast shadows.
assets.review: Cold review second candidate: clean green-key shelf replaces magenta-fringed original. Finished alpha and final size inspected.
